criteria.criterion: Every frozen A-E branch has one immutable head, a named strength, a disposition, and at least one destination.
The repo has one canonical Knowledge Wiki root and no public Wiki or proof-browser route.
All five divergent NYC Artist Coalition census observations are preserved while the canonical total and its portfolio projection remain held.
The selected cross-branch synthesis pages exist as governed, reachable pages in the canonical Wiki.
Every path in the exact PR diff is assigned once to a review unit of no more than 50 paths and 10,000 added lines.
Pull-request CI runs the repository check, including this closure suite and its mutation tests.
Machine success does not impersonate content approval, rights clearance, production approval, or the merge decision.
Branch-specific parallel roots, generated fixture corpora, and remote-ref-dependent checks are not required by the converged product.
